ProfileSwitcher.label: Profile
ProfileSwitcher.runningTimerText: The timer for “{name}” is stopped and booked before the profile changes.

CreateProfileDialog.title: New profile
CreateProfileDialog.description: Each profile has its own projects, activities and time entries.

UnavailableProfileDialog.missingText: The profile file could not be found or is not a valid Taktra profile. Removing the profile from the list does not touch any file.
UnavailableProfileDialog.newerVersionText: This profile was created or updated by a newer version of Taktra and cannot be opened by this version. Update Taktra to use it again. Removing the profile from the list does not touch any file.
UnavailableProfileDialog.migrationFailedText: This version of Taktra could not update the profile to its file format. The file was not changed, so the previous version of Taktra can still open it. Removing the profile from the list does not touch any file.

WelcomeView.title: Welcome to Taktra
WelcomeView.text: Create a profile to start tracking your time, or open an existing profile file.
WelcomeView.missingText: The file of the selected profile could not be found or opened. Create a new profile, open a profile file, or remove the profile from the list.
WelcomeView.sampleText: Just want to look around first?
WelcomeView.newerVersionText: The selected profile was created or updated by a newer version of Taktra. Update Taktra, choose another profile, or remove it from the list.
WelcomeView.migrationFailedText: The selected profile could not be updated to the file format of this Taktra version. The file was not changed. Choose another profile, keep using it with the previous Taktra version, or remove it from the list.

TimerView.title: Timer
TimerView.recentEmpty: Activities you track will show up here for a quick start.
TimerView.discardConfirmText: The running time is not booked and the entry is deleted.

TrackingView.deleteConfirmText: The time entry is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

TimeEntryDialog.title: New entry
TimeEntryDialog.durationInvalid: Please enter a duration between 1 minute and 24 hours.
TimeEntryDialog.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
TimeEntryDialog.newActivityTags: Tags for the new activity “{name}”. They apply to all of its entries.

TagPicker.label: Tags
TagPicker.description: Tags belong to the activity and apply to all of its entries.

ProjectsView.title: Projects
ProjectsView.deleteConfirmText: The project is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

ProjectDetailView.subtitle: Project
ProjectDetailView.empty: No activities yet. Activities are created when you track time.
ProjectDetailView.emptyPeriod: No time tracked in this period.

TagsView.title: Tags
TagsView.deleteConfirmText: The tag is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

TagDetailView.subtitle: Tag
TagDetailView.empty: No time has been tracked on activities with this tag yet.
TagDetailView.emptyPeriod: No time tracked on activities with this tag in this period.

TagBadges.more: {count, plural, one {# more tag} other {# more tags}}

ReportsView.title: Reports
ReportsView.empty: No time tracked in this period.

ExportView.title: Export
ExportView.empty: No completed entries in this period.

ReportBreakdown.overlap: An entry counts towards every tag of its activity, so tag shares can overlap and add up to more than 100 %.

miniTimer.title: Mini timer
miniTimer.label: Show mini timer
miniTimer.description: Shows a small always-on-top window with the running timer while Taktra is minimized or covered by other windows.

global.title: Global shortcuts
global.description: Work in every app, also while Taktra runs in the background.
global.quickStartDescription: Search an activity and start its timer.
global.unavailable: This shortcut is already used by another app or the system. Record a different one.

app.title: App shortcuts
app.description: Work while a Taktra window is focused. Single keys are ignored while typing.

UpdatesSettings.title: Updates
UpdatesSettings.label: Check for updates automatically
UpdatesSettings.description: Looks for new versions on GitHub at start and every few hours. Updates are downloaded in the background and installed when you quit Taktra. Without a connection, nothing happens.

ProfileGeneralSettings.nameDescription: Stored in the profile file. Renaming does not change the file name.

DeleteProfileSection.title: Delete profile
DeleteProfileSection.description: Moves the profile file to the trash and removes the profile from Taktra.
DeleteProfileSection.confirmText: The profile file will be moved to the trash. You can restore it from there as long as the trash has not been emptied.
